programme.title: The Royal Scandal
programme.desc: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Cathy and Frank partner with a beautiful insurance investigator in the recovery of stolen art. Frank is smitten with her, even though it becomes more apparent she may be the mastermind behind the theft.

programme.title: Dinotopia 6: The Exit
programme.desc: After a plane crash, two opposing half-brothers find themselves on an amazing lost island where enlightened pacifist humans and intelligent talking dinosaurs have created a utopian medieval society. But imminent disaster approaches.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Merlin's Apprentice
programme.desc: Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Icon
programme.desc: On the eve of the elections in Russia, there's an outbreak of a mysterious disease. The British are curious to find out what's going on, so they need to send someone. An official knows someone, Jason Monk, an American Agent who worked deep cover in Russia during the Cold War. He approaches Monk, who initially refuses till he tells Monk that he can help him settle some old scores and to see his daughter whom he left when he was pulled out. So Monk goes and makes contact with an old friend and a Russian policewoman. They learn that someone is trying to manipulate the election.

programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Jessica
programme.desc: The Bergman sisters couldn't be more different. Jessica is always willing to help her farmer father. Spoiled Meg is destined for a different fate. Her mother is raising her to be the perfect wife, destined to marry successfully and help the family escape poverty.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Aces 'N Eights
programme.desc: Already taking a gamble settling in the uncharted west, the peaceful settlers of a town destined for railroad greatness suddenly find themselves being ruthlessly gunned down. With no law and order to be found, justice falls onto the shoulders of an elderly rancher (played by Ernest Borgnine) and an accomplished, but retired, gunslinger (played by Casper Van Dien).

programme.title: Farscape: The Peacekeeper Wars
programme.desc: American science fiction series centering on human astronaut John Crichton as the fate of the Peacekeeper race rests on his shoulders. Brought back by the Peacekeeper Alliance, Crichton is their last hope when a monstrous war is waged by the sinister Scarran Empire, and the resilient astronaut must do all he can to protect the people from being destroyed, and the universe from being consumed by the plans of the evil empire. The two-part series follows on from the original Farscape series which, after its cancellation, was left needing to be brought to a conclusion.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Championship game. Olympiacos - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Championship game. Olympiacos - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Championship game. Olympiacos - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.desc: Imagine a place that holds everything you've ever wanted. High slopes and good timber for cover and den sites. Water. Your very own herds to hunt and all the wide open space you need for the chase. But others of your kind also want this place. They will challenge you for it. How far will you go to defend it? In the northeast corner of Yellowstone, the wolves of the Druid Peak Pack have long held sway, but their power is waning. The old leaders of the clan cannot stand against the challenge of the invading Slough Creek Pack. But the conquering wolves will find this no safe haven. Here, they will meet a strange and terrible fate. And though in exile, the Druids will rebuild their clan and gather the strength to return. In this beautiful but dangerous place, there is bounty and cruelty, loyalty and banishment, triumph and death. This is the story of the battle for the perfect valley and the high price wolves will pay for paradise.

programme.desc: Imagine a place that holds everything you've ever wanted. High slopes and good timber for cover and den sites. Water. Your very own herds to hunt and all the wide open space you need for the chase. But others of your kind also want this place. They will challenge you for it. How far will you go to defend it? In the northeast corner of Yellowstone, the wolves of the Druid Peak Pack have long held sway, but their power is waning. The old leaders of the clan cannot stand against the challenge of the invading Slough Creek Pack. But the conquering wolves will find this no safe haven. Here, they will meet a strange and terrible fate. And though in exile, the Druids will rebuild their clan and gather the strength to return. In this beautiful but dangerous place, there is bounty and cruelty, loyalty and banishment, triumph and death. This is the story of the battle for the perfect valley and the high price wolves will pay for paradise.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Crocodiles rule Africa's waters: stealthy, deadly, and unstoppable. Watch them face lions, cheetahs, and buffalo in explosive encounters.

programme.title: Wild Lapland
programme.desc: A lyrical portrayal of the enchanting, wild creatures who call Lapland home.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Are Ewe Pregnant?. The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol Shebang. It's been a year of farming for the Pol family. Even with Charles recovering from his injury, the farm's showing no signs of slowing down! Beth takes the next step with her bees to grow the colony and harvest honey.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: The Kalahari. Land of great thirst. Endless mirages of red and yellow sand merge with a shimmering horizon. Summer rains bring brief explosions of life, painting the landscape in vibrant colours, only to be soaked up by the thirsty earth and returned once again to the desert. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: Deep Sea Dwellers
programme.desc: Movie special-effect gurus are forever trying to invent more compelling creatures from other planets, hoping to terrorize our imaginations. To do this, they often draw from the natural world, and few creatures fit the bill more than the cephalopods: shapeshifters, with three hearts, blue blood and holes in their brains. But while they might look like creatures from another galaxy, these aliens have called Earth home for hundreds of millions of years. In our quest to find intelligent life, we search among the stars, but perhaps we should be looking closer to home. The octopus, squid and cuttlefish are some of the most intelligent creatures in the animal kingdom. They have colonized all of the world's oceans and are widespread in even the darkest corners of the abyss. So, forget Hollywood; there are aliens in the deep.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: Domestic pets or wild animal rescues, the Critter Fixers do it all. Some rescued alligators need a little medical attention; an owl is victim of a hit-and-run; a baby fawn has some serious issues; a wild king snake was attacked by dogs; a baby squirrel was attacked by a pet cat; and a newborn wild piglet is hypothermic and needing help.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. But only the most ingenious, industrious and adaptable thrive here, forging clever alliances, exploiting fleeting opportunities, and pushing the limits of endurance in a world where every drop of energy — and every grain of sand — matters.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets
programme.desc: Drs. Hodges an Ferguson are always busy with a hospital full of patients from around rural Georgia. A Maltese puppy with failure to thrive is brought in. Dr. Hodges tries to rid aquarium fish of nasty parasites, after taking his son out for his first cow preg check. A surgery on a dog with a growth on his neck quickly turns tense when the dog starts bleeding profusely, and a pregnant goat and a horse with a stifle problem round out the episode.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa Compilation
programme.desc: Rhinos, Koalas and Bears... Oh My!. Journey through Zoo Tampa's Asia and Australia exhibits as a pair of clouded leopards move into their new home and a sun bear goes to the dentist.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: The PVS staff make sure every animal has a fighting chance. From tiny puppies and rabbits, large cows and horses, and creepy crawlies, on this episode of The Incredible Dr. Pol, it's a fun mix of, "aww," "wow," and "yuck!" The vets are out on farms calls! Dr. Pol tangles with a feisty angus bull, pregnancy checks a herd at House Dairy, and pays a visit to Clay Knob to look at a cow with a peculiar problem.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! follows the adventures of a troll named Wally and his pet dragon, Norville, who live in a forest with giants, goblins, ogres, sprites and other mythical creatures. Wally uses his magic stick to make words come to life on screen that start with a specific letter, sound or rhyme. Each episode features a new set of magic words that Wally uses to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

Rovak tells the Midknights how and why the Gnomes were kidnapped, but the story is interrupted when the two Ogres show up. As the Midknights and Rovak hide from the Ogres, Millie concocts a potion. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Pinky Malinky
programme.desc: Pinky Malinky, a 12-year-old Middle School student, just so happens to be an anthropomorphic hot dog, who endeavors to climb up the social ladder with his two human friends, Babs Buttman and JJ Jameson.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When the Midknights' ship is set off course, the team must survive treacherous new waters. Before Max can enact her plan, she is summoned to Wizard Court where Mumblin is on trial for his life. Max must help Mumblin prove that he is a good wizard and that he escaped the afterlife to help the Midknights defeat Fendra. If Max can't, Mumblin will be sent away for good. Max calls on the Midknights to testify on Mumblin's behalf. When those attempts fail, Max takes the stand. At first, Max's emotional testimony seems to win over the court, but her pleas for Mumblin's freedom backfire and Mumblin is ultimately found guilty. Luckily, Kevyn discovers a way to save Mumblin. Max must battle the Worms of Justice and if she wins, then Mumblin will be set free. Transported to a desert, Max battles giant worms. In the end, Max defeats the worms and Mumblin wins his trial. Unfortunately, the Midknights are sent back to their boat, which is headed straight for a massive waterfall!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Spongicus: Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket! In its place, he has built a Roman coliseum and announces there will be a gladiator show, which means togas, chariots, and ferocious lionfish. And on top of all that, it's free! No one in Bikini Bottom can resist, not even Mr. Krabs! Suction Cup Symphony: The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win. He immediately gets to work on his masterpiece, but when SpongeBob and Patrick keep disrupting Squidward's concentration, it looks like they might ruin his chance at musical stardom.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: With the team busy training, Jawbreaker feels left out. But when he encounters Aftermath suffering from energy depletion, they accidentally get stuck together! Can they survive each other and what lurks in the wilderness?

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: Frankie, Phoenix, and Heath search Hades's underworld factory for their missing friends and discover a surprising culprit. // Frankie and friends must "weave their own webs" and battle a foe to save the Monster Fest.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: Max & the Midknights fly to the village of Tresk to search for the missing Gnomes and discover a series of mysterious holes in the nearby forest. Before they can investigate, the kids are chased by two angry Ogres and run into Rovak, one of the kidnapped Gnomes from Tresk. Desperate to evade the Ogres, Rovak and the Midknights take shelter in a cottage owned by their friends, Bean and Barley. Rovak tells the Midknights how and why the Gnomes were kidnapped, but the story is interrupted when the two Ogres show up. As the Midknights and Rovak hide from the Ogres, Millie concocts a potion. But the kids are caught and the potion has an unexpected result: it turns the Midknights into gnomes. Meanwhile, Mumblin begins community service at Outpost 71, a mysterious factory run by penguins. Mumblin is relieved to learn that his friend Lenny is also serving community service, but when Mumblin learns that his sentence lasts ten thousand years, he decides to escape. Unfortunately, there's no way out. Or is there?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: Alessandra e Valerio non potrebbero essere più diversi. Le loro strade si incrociano per caso su un tram e passano una notte assieme. Il giorno dopo si rendono conto di lavorare nella stessa scuola.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Ben Affleck, Gal Gadot, Henry Cavill e Amy Adams nel kolossal di Zack Snyder. I supereroi della Dc Comics si radunano per fronteggiare l'implacabile alieno Steppenwolf.

programme.title: Non così vicino
programme.desc: Marc Forster dirige Tom Hanks in una pellicola dolceamara. Dopo la morte della moglie, Otto è un uomo rigido e solo. Ma la sua vita sarà sconvolta dall’arrivo di una nuova vicina.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: Disperato e alla ricerca di denaro per salvare la figlia malata, Ben Richards si unisce al programma tv "The Running Man", una competizione in cui i concorrenti devono sopravvivere per 30 giorni mentre vengono braccati da assassini professionisti.

programme.title: Downton Abbey - Il gran finale
programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga tratta dall'omonimo period drama televisivo, gli aristocratici Crawley affrontano lo scandalo pubblico scoppiato per il divorzio di Lady Mary, candidata a prendere in mano le redini della famiglia.

programme.title: Last Breath
programme.desc: La storia vera di un gruppo di palombari esperti, che sfidano la natura per salvare un compagno di equipaggio rimasto intrappolato a centinaia di metri sotto la superficie dell'oceano.

programme.title: Fidanzata in affitto
programme.desc: Commedia irriverente con Jennifer Lawrence, Andrew Barth Feldman e Matthew Broderick. Una ragazza in difficolta' economiche accetta di frequentare il figlio di una ricca coppia.

programme.title: Romantiche
programme.desc: Pilar Fogliati debutta alla regia con una brillante commedia a episodi. La talentuosa attrice interpreta con ironia quattro ragazze molto diverse tra loro.

programme.title: L'ammissione
programme.desc: Tina Fey e Paul Rudd in una divertente commedia. La vita di Portia, responsabile alle ammissioni di Princeton, viene sconvolta quando ritrova John, un ex compagno del college.

programme.title: La Riunione Di Condominio
programme.desc: In un edificio nel centro di Madrid, una normale assemblea tra vicini per decidere della sostituzione dell'ascensore si trasforma in una guerra. Tutto perché si viene a sapere che un nuovo inquilino con problemi di mentali affitterà un appartamento.

programme.title: Rosa Elettrica: Giannetta Vs Di Napoli
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco Di Napoli ripercorrono la loro esperienza durante le riprese, tra aneddoti divertenti e curiosità dal backstage.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: La stranezza
programme.desc: 4 David di Donatello al film di Roberto Andò con Toni Servillo affiancato dal duo comico Ficarra e Picone. Sicilia, 1920: l'incontro con due scapestrati becchini con la vocazione per il teatro ispira a Luigi Pirandello la stesura di "Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore".

programme.title: Coda - I segni del cuore
programme.desc: 3 premi Oscar 2022 al remake di Sian Heder premiato al Sundance. Ruby, unica udente in una famiglia di sordomuti, sogna un futuro nel canto ma non vuole lasciare i suoi cari.

programme.title: Edtv
programme.desc: La rete True TV è in crisi. Per aumentare gli ascolti, la direttrice decide di seguire 24 ore su 24 la vita di un uomo normale, con radicali cambiamenti nella vita del protagonista.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Il traditore
programme.desc: Marco Bellocchio dirige Pierfrancesco Favino nella biografia del 'boss dei due mondi', Tommaso Buscetta, il primo pentito della mafia, che testimonio' nel maxiprocesso contro Cosa Nostra.

programme.title: Caro diario
programme.desc: Una delle pellicole piu' celebri di Nanni Moretti premiata a Cannes per la miglior regia. 3 capitoli di un'autobiografia collettiva: le ossessioni del regista si fondono con quelle del paese.

programme.title: La stanza del figlio
programme.desc: Palma d'Oro a Cannes per la toccante pellicola di Nanni Moretti, anche protagonista con Laura Morante. Legami familiari attraversati da luci e ombre, fino all’irruzione del dolore.

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe 2014 alla sceneggiatura per lo struggente racconto di una love story incredibile. Il solitario Theodore (Joaquin Phoenix) si innamora della voce di un sofisticato computer (Scarlett Johansson nella versione originale e Micaela Ramazzotti in quella italiana).

programme.title: Italia 1982 - Una storia azzurra
programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.title: Il cavaliere elettrico
programme.desc: Cult anni 70 di Sydney Pollack con Robert Redford e Jane Fonda. Un campione di rodeo ruba un cavallo e fugge verso le montagne, inseguito da una giornalista in cerca di scoop.

programme.title: Finale a sorpresa - Official Competition
programme.desc: Penelope Cruz e Antonio Banderas in una commedia sul mondo del cinema. Per realizzare un film, un miliardario ingaggia un'eccentrica regista e due divi in competizione tra loro.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel gangster-movie capolavoro di Brian De Palma, sceneggiato da Oliver Stone. Il rifugiato cubano Tony Montana scala i vertici della malavita e diventa il re del narcotraffico.

programme.title: Margin Call
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.title: Il cavaliere elettrico
programme.desc: Cult anni 70 di Sydney Pollack con Robert Redford e Jane Fonda. Un campione di rodeo ruba un cavallo e fugge verso le montagne, inseguito da una giornalista in cerca di scoop.

programme.title: The Michael Jackson Story
programme.desc: Grazie alle testimonianze di persone vicine a lui, tra cui sua sorella La Toya, si ripercorre l'ascesa di Jackson da bambino prodigio a icona mondiale. Tuttavia, alcuni comportamenti discutibili sollevano interrogativi inquietanti.

programme.title: The Michael Jackson Story
programme.desc: Michael Jackson firma il contratto con la Sony ed esplodono le accuse di abusi sessuali su minori. La squadra di Michael si è data da fare per preservare intatti sia il suo impero commerciale che la sua immagine.

programme.title: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - Ep. 476 - Intervista A Edoardo Leo
programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.title: La teoria del tutto
programme.desc: Oscar a Eddie Redmayne, al fianco di Felicity Jones nel biopic sullo scienziato Stephen Hawking: una vita segnata dalla malattia, dalla scienza e dall'insuperabile amore per la moglie Jane.

programme.title: The Lost King
programme.desc: Stephen Frears dirige Sally Hawkins e Steve Coogan in un film Sky Original. Ispirata dal Riccardo III shakespeariano, una donna si mette alla ricerca delle perdute spoglie del sovrano.

programme.title: Les Mise'rables
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: Il cavaliere elettrico
programme.desc: Cult anni 70 di Sydney Pollack con Robert Redford e Jane Fonda. Un campione di rodeo ruba un cavallo e fugge verso le montagne, inseguito da una giornalista in cerca di scoop.

programme.title: Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend
programme.desc: Lamborghini, dagli inizi modesti come costruttore di trattori alla famigerata rivalità con Enzo Ferrari, ma anche la storia dell'Italia degli anni '50, un Paese impegnato nella complessa transizione verso una nuova modernità industrializzata.

programme.title: La Voce Di Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Il 29 gennaio 2024 gli operatori della Mezzaluna rossa ricevono la telefonata di Liyan Hamada, una quindicenne di Gaza intrappolata in macchina assieme a Hind Rajab, sua cugina di cinque anni, a seguito dell'attacco di un carro armato israeliano.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)
programme.desc: La 'sporca guerra' secondo Stanley Kubrick in un film epocale con Matthew Modine. Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: Primavera
programme.desc: Cecilia, una violinista di grande talento costretta a vivere in un orfanotrofio, incontra Vivaldi, che diventa il suo maestro. Grazie alla sua guida e alla sua musica, trova il coraggio di seguire la sua passione.

programme.title: Decision to Leave
programme.desc: Miglior regia a Cannes a Park Chan-Wook per un noir hitchcockiano. Uno strano suicidio in montagna porta un detective a sospettare della moglie della vittima, innamorandosene all'istante.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Biopic con Kristen Stewart nei panni della Principessa Diana. Natale 1991: nella tenuta reale di Sandringham, Lady D. matura la decisione di interrompere il matrimonio con Carlo.

programme.title: I guerrieri della notte
programme.desc: Capolavoro di Walter Hill e un classico dell'action. New York: accusati di omicidio, i Warriors devono sfuggire alla ritorsione delle bande rivali nel corso di una lunga notte di agguati.

programme.title: Al di la' dei sogni
programme.desc: Toccante film soprannaturale con Robin Williams. Un uomo viaggia dal Paradiso all'Inferno per salvare la moglie suicida, condannata alla dannazione eterna. Oscar agli effetti speciali.

programme.title: Reagan: Un Presidente sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Penelope Ann Miller e Jon Voight nel biopic che ripercorre la vita privata e politica di Ronald Reagan, Presidente degli Stati Uniti negli anni 80. Dall'infanzia in Illinois, alla carriera hollywoodiana fino al palcoscenico mondiale come capo della Casa Bianca.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Primavera
programme.desc: Cecilia, una violinista di grande talento costretta a vivere in un orfanotrofio, incontra Vivaldi, che diventa il suo maestro. Grazie alla sua guida e alla sua musica, trova il coraggio di seguire la sua passione.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: Ave, Cesare!
programme.desc: Siamo nei primi anni 50, Eddie Mannix è impegnato a risolvere tutti i problemi degli attori e registi della Capitol Pictures. I suoi ultimi incarichi comprendono un regista scontento, un cowboy cantante, un bel nuotatore e un affascinante ballerino.

programme.title: Al di la' dei sogni
programme.desc: Toccante film soprannaturale con Robin Williams. Un uomo viaggia dal Paradiso all'Inferno per salvare la moglie suicida, condannata alla dannazione eterna. Oscar agli effetti speciali.

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: Pulp fiction
programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Unbroken
programme.desc: Sceneggiato dai fratelli Coen, war movie biografico di Angelina Jolie. Seconda guerra mondiale: reclutato in aviazione, l'atleta Louis Zamperini finisce in mano ai giapponesi nel Pacifico.

programme.title: Speciale: Rosa Elettrica
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco di Napoli in fuga attraverso l’Italia: un dietro le quinte svela retroscena, location e scene action della serie.

programme.title: Redemption Day
programme.desc: Gary Dourdan in un action con Andy Garcia. Di ritorno da una missione contro l'Isis, un ufficiale, devastato dagli orrori bellici, deve salvare la moglie rapita da un gruppo terroristico.

programme.title: Il cecchino
programme.desc: Action di Michele Placido con Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz e Luca Argentero. Un misterioso tiratore scelto prende di mira i poliziotti durante l'arresto di una banda di criminali.

programme.title: Assassinio sul Nilo
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige e interpreta, con Gal Gadot e Annette Bening, l'adattamento del giallo di Agatha Christie. In crociera sul Nilo, Poirot indaga sull'omicidio di un'ereditiera.

programme.title: Blood father
programme.desc: John Link, uomo dal passato turbolento, cerca di proteggere la figlia dal fidanzato violento, mentalmente instabile e membro di un'organizzazione criminale dedita allo spaccio di stupefacenti.

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Anya Taylor-Joy e Chris Hemsworth nello spettacolare prequel di George Miller. Mentre il mondo va in rovina, la giovane Furiosa cade nelle mani di un'orda di motociclisti.

programme.title: I mercenari 3
programme.desc: Il cast stellare ritorna nel terzo capitolo dell'adrenalinica saga action. La ricomparsa di uno storico nemico costringe Barney a trovare nuove forze per l'ultima missione.

programme.title: Nemesi
programme.desc: Walter Hill dirige Sigourney Weaver e Michelle Rodriguez in un action sulla vendetta. Rachel, un diabolico chirurgo plastico, sottopone il killer di suo fratello a un cambiamento di sesso.

programme.title: The Equalizer - Il vendicatore
programme.desc: Denzel Washington in un action ispirato alla serie anni '80 "Un giustiziere a New York". Un ex federale torna ad affrontare il crimine per salvare una giovane prostituta.

programme.title: Assassinio sul Nilo
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige e interpreta, con Gal Gadot e Annette Bening, l'adattamento del giallo di Agatha Christie. In crociera sul Nilo, Poirot indaga sull'omicidio di un'ereditiera.

programme.title: Mr Vendetta
programme.desc: Su consiglio della sua fidanzata anarchica, un operaio appena licenziato rapisce la figlia del suo ex capo, sperando di usare i soldi del riscatto per pagare il trapianto di rene della sorella.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Gioco pericoloso
programme.desc: Gioco pericoloso.

programme.desc: Denzel Washington nel secondo capitolo action diretto da Antoine Fuqua. L'ex agente segreto Robert McCall torna a combattere il crimine quando una sua amica viene assassinata.

programme.title: Pig, il piano di Rob
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage in un film ambientato nelle impervie lande dell’Oregon. Un solitario cacciatore di tartufi vive nella sua fattoria in compagnia dell’amata e preziosa scrofa. Quando l’animale viene rapito, l’uomo si mette in viaggio verso i luoghi del suo passato per ritrovarlo.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Action con Robert De Niro e John Travolta. Un ufficiale americano si ritira sui monti per dimenticare gli orrori della guerra in Bosnia. La visita di un ex soldato serbo riapre le ferite.

programme.title: Assassinio sull'Orient Express
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige un super cast con Michelle Pfeiffer, Penelope Cruz e Johnny Depp. Il detective Poirot indaga su un omicidio avvenuto su un treno. Dal bestseller di Agatha Christie.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.desc: Negli anni 1860, la francocanadese vivace e indipendente Vivienne Le Coudy intraprende un viaggio con l'immigrato danese Holger Olsen, cercando di costruire una vita insieme nella polverosa città di Elk Flats, Nevada.

programme.title: Venom: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga, Venom e il suo ospite umano, Eddie Brock, sono di ritorno a New York ma devono guardarsi dalle forze dell'ordine e dagli Xenofagi, indistruttibili mostri alieni provenienti dal pianeta di Venom.

programme.title: Antigang - Nell'ombra del crimine
programme.desc: Action con Jean Reno, Alban Lenoir e Caterina Murino. Parigi: una squadra di poliziotti dai metodi anticonvenzionali si lancia all'inseguimento di una spietata banda di rapinatori.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Vin Diesel, 'The Rock', Jason Statham e il compianto Paul Walker nel settimo capitolo della saga. Dominic e compagni devono difendersi da un killer deciso a vendicare il fratello.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2 - Senza perdono
programme.desc: Denzel Washington nel secondo capitolo action diretto da Antoine Fuqua. L'ex agente segreto Robert McCall torna a combattere il crimine quando una sua amica viene assassinata.

programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige un super cast con Michelle Pfeiffer, Penelope Cruz e Johnny Depp. Il detective Poirot indaga su un omicidio avvenuto su un treno. Dal bestseller di Agatha Christie.

programme.title: Lady Vendetta
programme.desc: Ingiustamente incarcerata per l'omicidio di un bambino, una donna fa della vendetta verso i veri colpevoli la sua ragione di vita.

programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al western di Quentin Tarantino con Christoph Waltz, Jamie Foxx e Leonardo DiCaprio. Uno schiavo nero riacquista la liberta' e corre a salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.desc: Antoine Fuqua dirige Denzel Washington nel terzo capitolo della celebre saga. Il sicario Robert McCall si è ritirato in Sicilia. Presto però sarà richiamato a sporcarsi le mani.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: Nell'ottavo capitolo della saga, Tom Cruise alias Agente Hunt corre contro il tempo per impedire allo spietato sistema di Intelligenza Artificiale chiamato Entita' di distruggere il pianeta.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take - Senza respiro
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original con Casey Affleck, Sam Claflin e Michelle Monaghan. Il suicidio di una paziente compromette l'equilibrio familiare di uno psichiatra.

programme.desc: Action fantascientifico con Logan Marshall-Green. Rimasto paralizzato dopo un'aggressione in cui ha perso la moglie, Grey si fa impiantare un chip sperimentale per vendicarsi.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: Dylan O'Brien e Michael Keaton in un action dal romanzo di Vince Flynn. Sconvolto dalla morte della fidanzata, uccisa in un attentato, uno studente entra nella Cia e diventa un killer.

programme.title: Senza sangue
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie dirige Salma Hayek in un intenso dramma ispirato al romanzo di Alessandro Baricco. Una donna ritrova dopo anni uno dei responsabili del massacro della sua famiglia e deve decidere come sia giusto vendicarsi.

programme.title: Largo Winch - Il prezzo del denaro
programme.desc: Tomer Sisley contro James Franco nell'action che rilancia il personaggio creato da Jean Van Hamme. Il magnate Largo Winch, al centro di un complotto, deve regolare i conti con il passato e intraprendere una pericolosa avventura in vari paesi del mondo per ritrovare il figlio rapito.

programme.title: Old Way, The
programme.desc: La tranquillita' di un ex pistolero viene sconvolta dall'omicidio della moglie. In preda alla sete di vendetta, inizia una furiosa caccia agli assassini che coinvolgera' anche sua figlia, decisa a seguire le orme del padre (US 2023).

programme.desc: Russell Crowe in un thriller psicologico dove la banalità del quotidiano degenera in pura follia. Una donna intrappolata nel traffico usa con troppa insistenza il clacson, scatenando gli impulsi rabbiosi di un autista psicopatico che da quel momento comincia a perseguitarla.

programme.desc: Russell Crowe e Joaquin Phoenix nel capolavoro di Ridley Scott vincitore di 5 Oscar. Dopo lo sterminio della sua famiglia, il generale Maximus viene catturato per combattere al Colosseo.

programme.desc: Anya Taylor-Joy e Chris Hemsworth nello spettacolare prequel di George Miller. Mentre il mondo va in rovina, la giovane Furiosa cade nelle mani di un'orda di motociclisti.

programme.title: John Wick - Capitolo 2
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves torna a vestire i panni del killer nel sequel con Riccardo Scamarcio e Claudia Gerini. Un debito con un boss camorrista costringe John Wick a impugnare nuovamente le armi.

programme.title: John Wick 3 - Parabellum
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga action con Keanu Reeves. John Wick ha ucciso un gangster e gli viene concessa un'ora di tempo per fuggire da New York ed evitare di essere eliminato.

programme.title: Speciale: Rosa Elettrica
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco di Napoli in fuga attraverso l’Italia: un dietro le quinte svela retroscena, location e scene action della serie.

programme.title: Valerian e la città dei mille pianeti
programme.desc: Blockbuster fantascientifico di Luc Besson con Cara Delevingne. Due agenti governativi vengono spediti nella metropoli di Alpha per fronteggiare le forze che minacciano l'universo.

programme.title: Nella tana dei lupi 2 - Pantera
programme.desc: Gerard Butler nel secondo capitolo dell'action-thriller che vede nel cast Salvatore Esposito e Fortunato Cerlino. Big Nick vola in Europa sulle tracce della banda della Pantera.

programme.title: La mummia (2017)
programme.desc: Avventura con Tom Cruise, Sofia Boutella e Russell Crowe. La regina di un mondo arcaico, risvegliata da un sonno millenario, scatena sul mondo la sua sete di vendetta.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: Action catastrofico con Helen Hunt e Bill Paxton. Sopravvissuta da bambina a un uragano, una metereologa si trasforma in "cacciatrice di tornado"...

programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della strepitosa saga di fantascienza con Keanu Reeves e Laurence Fishburne. Neo lotta senza tregua per evitare la distruzione di Zion e salvare Trinity da un oscuro destino.

programme.title: The Twin - L'altro volto del male
programme.desc: Teresa Palmer in un thriller dalle atmosfere suggestive. Dopo la morte del figlio, una coppia si trasferisce in Finlandia con il fratello gemello; ma quest'ultimo si comporta in modo strano.

programme.desc: Un misterioso nuovo detenuto finisce nella prigione di una città di frontiera. Lo sceriffo del posto si ritrova a dover affrontare l'ira di un brutale cartello della droga, che agisce senza pietà.

programme.desc: Crime-thriller con Frank Grillo, Josh Hartnett e Melissa Leo. In prigione per omicidio, la matriarca di una famiglia del crimine tesse le fila della malavita dal carcere.

programme.title: State a casa
programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins nei panni di Hannibal Lecter in un thriller con Edward Norton e Ralph Fiennes. Un detective consulta lo psichiatra criminale per catturare un killer detto Lupo Mannaro.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: George Clooney e Jennifer Lopez in un thriller di Steven Soderbergh, tratto da un romanzo di Elmore Leonard. Un rapinatore gentiluomo evade dal carcere e prende in ostaggio una poliziotta.

programme.title: Acid
programme.desc: L'angoscia per il cambiamento climatico in un fanta-thriller con Guillaume Canet e Laetitia Dosch. Durante un'anomala ondata di caldo, una perturbazione di pioggia acida e letale minaccia l'Europa, costringendo gli abitanti alla fuga verso una salvezza che appare impossibile.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.desc: Luc Besson reinventa Bram Stoker nel successo gotico-romantico con Caleb Landry Jones. Accecato dal dolore per la perdita della moglie, il principe Vlad diventa vampiro.

programme.title: Miss Sloane - Giochi di potere
programme.desc: John Madden dirige Jessica Chastain nei panni di un'impetuosa eroina della verita'. Una lobbista deve contrastare una proposta di legge sul controllo delle armi. Passera' al fronte opposto.

programme.title: The Watchers - Loro ti guardano
programme.desc: In un bosco nell'Irlanda occidentale, quattro persone si nascondono in un rifugio per proteggersi dalle mostruose creature che appaiono ogni notte. Mentre cercano una via d'uscita, devono fare i conti con l'inspiegabile mistero della foresta.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: M. Night Shyamalan dirige un formidabile James McAvoy. Tre ragazze vengono rapite da un maniaco con 23 diverse personalità, ma la più pericolosa è ancora nascosta nella sua psiche.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della storica saga horror apocalittica. Una ragazza scopre il legame tra un incubo ricorrente e una premonizione avuta da sua nonna che negli anni 60 salvò molte vite. Ma la Morte non dimentica e inizia a perseguitare i discendenti dei sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone dalla parte della legge in un appassionante thriller con Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel e Ray Liotta. Lo sceriffo di una piccola cittadina del New Jersey, abitata soprattutto da poliziotti e per questo soprannominata 'Cop Land', non ha mai fatto carriera. Si limita a svolgere mansioni di poco conto all'ombra dei più agguerriti, e quotati, colleghi in divisa. Ma l'occasione per dimostrare il suo valore arriva, quando è costretto a indagare su una tragedia provocata proprio da uno sbirro e insabbiata dal resto dei poliziotti.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: America Latina
programme.desc: Elio Germano nello spiazzante thriller dei fratelli D'Innocenzo. Latina: un dentista vive in una villa con la sua famiglia. Un giorno, scendendo nelle cantine, incontra l'assurdo.

programme.title: Il codice da Vinci
programme.desc: Tom Hanks in un thriller di Ron Howard tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Per scagionarsi da un'accusa di omicidio, un esperto di simbologia dovra' svelare uno sconcertante segreto.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: Sophie Thatcher e Jack Quaid nel pazzesco fanta-thriller di Drew Hancock. Nella villa di un miliardario, inventore di una rivoluzionaria app per incontri, un gruppo di ragazzi viene travolto da una serie di imprevedibili eventi, fra insospettabili robot e un malloppo da rubare.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: L'uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Elisabeth Moss in un horror targato Blumhouse che rispolvera il personaggio creato da H.G. Wells. Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins, Julianne Moore e Gary Oldman nel sequel di Ridley Scott. Fuggito dal manicomio, Hannibal Lecter si rifugia a Firenze, ma due vecchie conoscenze lo braccano.

programme.title: Into the Ashes
programme.desc: Le ceneri di un passato criminale tornano a vivere con Frank Grillo, Marguerite Moreau e Luke Grimes. Un ex rapinatore inizia una nuova vita, ma la vendetta dei vecchi soci lo perseguita.

programme.title: L'esercito delle 12 scimmie
programme.desc: Visionario fanta-action di Terry Gilliam con Bruce Willis e Brad Pitt. Anno 2035: un ergastolano viene mandato nel passato per scoprire le cause dell'epidemia che ha decimato l'umanita'.

programme.desc: Tom Hanks in un thriller di Ron Howard tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Per scagionarsi da un'accusa di omicidio, un esperto di simbologia dovra' svelare uno sconcertante segreto.

programme.desc: Spy-thriller bellico di Alfred Hitchcock. Alla vigilia della 2a guerra mondiale, un operaio viene accusato di sabotaggio. Per provare la sua innocenza dovrà scoprire i veri colpevoli.

programme.title: Naked Singularity
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original con John Boyega, Olivia Cooke e Bill Skarsgard. Deluso dal sistema giudiziario, un avvocato idealista si ritrova coinvolto nel furto di una partita di droga.

programme.title: Monolith
programme.desc: Thriller Sky tratto dall'omonima graphic novel. Sola nel deserto, una donna deve liberare il figlio intrappolato in una macchina blindata.
